originalItemSources.title: Prayer of Protection
originalItemSources.originalDescription: A family prayer found inside the Ornate Music Box. Its complete owner-approved text and separate readable Journal must be verified before player handout. Reading it at Dahlia’s Art Studio Sune altar reveals the concealed Candle Workshop passage.

originalItemSources.title: Prayer of Devotion
originalItemSources.originalDescription:
A careful transcription of an old prayer discovered inscribed into masonry. The words honor devotion, constancy, and love, with the unmistakable warmth of a hymn to Sune.

Age has weathered the stone from which it was copied, but not the intention behind the invocation. It is meant to be spoken, not merely collected.
